title: Keep recorded staffing visible while decisions are pending
summary: Recorded overtime now stays explicit on Tonight while seven-nurse allocation decisions are unresolved, and the administrator attention badge is no longer clipped by the settings control.
changes: Tonight now names recorded overtime nurses as well as showing the overtime count, including while a seven-nurse decision is still pending.
Seven-nurse decision state remains provisional until the allocation is resolved, but it no longer obscures who has already been recorded as overtime cover.
The administrator settings attention badge is repositioned so the circular header control no longer clips it into a red crescent.
Browser coverage now protects both pending seven-nurse overtime visibility and the administrator badge geometry.
